title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: route returning customers to a previous or preferred expert
summary: The routing controls, admin activation requirement, licensing description and publishing meter are supported by the current Microsoft documentation. The updated billing page does not contradict the briefing. One minor clarification remains: the configuration article gives no tenant-wide switch path, but the Responsible AI FAQ mentions a feature toggle without documenting its path or scope.

claims.claim: Publishing the previous/preferred expert playbook is reached in Copilot Service admin center through Customer support > Conversation orchestration > Prompt gallery > Assign to a previous or preferred expert scenario > Assign to a previous or preferred expert > Publish.

In Copilot Service admin center, go to Customer support > Conversation Orchestration.
In the drop-down field, select a scenario category, and then select a playbook template.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment / Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Returning async chats reconnect to the same representative when their total active conversations are below the active conversation limit.
claims.quote: Compare the representative's total active conversations against their limit. If the total is below the limit, the system reconnects the conversation to the same representative, even when the limit exceeds the configured capacity profile.

claims.claim: An administrator can configure next-best-representative fallback when the previous expert fails the async checks.
claims.quote: If the representative doesn't meet the presence requirements or reaches the active conversation limit, the system either keeps the conversation unassigned in the queue or assigns it to the next best representative, depending on administrator configuration.

claims.claim: An administrator can configure the failed async assignment to remain unassigned in the queue.
claims.quote:
